purpose: Recovered photographic Earth optical baseline; keep independent from the map/hologram atlas
note: Preserved historical geographic data asset. It is not the later RGBA atlas and must not be substituted with it.
source: NASA Earth Observatory / GEBCO rendered imagery
credit: Jesse Allen, NASA Earth Observatory; GEBCO, British Oceanographic Data Centre
processingProvenance: Recorded download and multiscale RGB normal/elevation generation; retained production output identified by its content-derived asset name, size and SHA-256. This audit did not regenerate or substitute the image.

reuseBasis.scope: NASA-published imagery and its derived image texture; no blanket grant for original GEBCO grid data
reuseBasis.policy: NASA permits reuse and republication of most Earth-site imagery, including commercial reuse, unless a separate copyright notice applies; preserve source credit.
